checklistRows.label: Decline consent control
checklistRows.explanation: Whether a first-layer reject, necessary-only, decline, refuse, or equivalent refusal option was observed on a sufficiently retained consent surface.
checklistRows.note: A first-layer consent surface had an accept option and non-essential cookie/purpose text, but no same-layer refusal option was retained. This describes first-layer availability only; CertScore.ai did not run a consent flow.

checklistRows.label: Accept consent control
checklistRows.explanation: An accept, accept-all, or allow-all control was observed from structured first-layer consent-surface evidence. This confirms availability, not the result of clicking it.
checklistRows.note: An accept consent control was observed from structured consent-control evidence. This confirms availability, not post-click behavior.

checklistRows.label: Options / settings / preferences control
checklistRows.explanation: Whether a first-layer options, settings, preferences, or manage-preferences control was observed on the retained consent surface.
checklistRows.note: No separate options/settings control was observed alongside the retained Accept control. Because no reject or equivalent refusal control was retained either, this is supporting context for the refusal-path review rather than a standalone options-control gap.
